interface.signature: def countOfNodes(n: int, graph: List[List[int]]) -> int

preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 1 and 10^4.
The length of the graph list is equal to the number of nodes n.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(neighbors, list) for neighbors in graph)
preconditions.description: Each element in the graph list is a list of neighbors.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= neighbor <= n for neighbors in graph for neighbor in neighbors)
preconditions.description: All neighbors are within the range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: len(graph) - 1 == sum(len(neighbors) for neighbors in graph) // 2
preconditions.description: The graph has exactly n-1 edges.

postconditions.description: The returned value is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(i+1, n+1) if bfs_distance(graph, i, j) % 2 == 0)
postconditions.description: The returned value is the count of pairs of nodes that are at even distance from each other.
